hints.content:
The function $g$ is positive $($i.e. $g(x)>0)$ whenever its graph is above the $x$-axis.

This is because the positive $y$-values are above the $x$-axis, and $y=g(x)$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x-axis scales by one, and the y-axis scales by four. The graph of the function y equals g of x is above the x-axis from x equals negative five to x equals two and one-half. It is below the x-axis after x equals two and one-half. The function is increasing from x equals negative five to x equals negative three. The function is decreasing after x equals negative three. The function is highlighted from x equals negative five to x equals two and one-half.

hints.content: Out of our options, the only correct interval is $1<x<2$.
